latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generates comprehensive FAERS-based comparative safety study designs for user-specified drug sets, comparators, and adverse event domains.

- Supports single-SOC, multi-drug comparison design across four workload configurations: Lite, Standard, Advanced, and Publication+
- Outputs include recommended primary plan, step-by-step module-level workflow, figure/table plan, validation/robustness strategy, minimal executable version, and publication upgrade path
- Recognizes and adapts to several research styles: drug class vs comparator, within-class, pharmacologic subgroups, and more
- Structured outputs suited for direct integration with pharmacovigilance data analysis and academic writing tools
- Includes detailed guidance on data source selection, drug normalization, comparator logic, outcome/PT definition, analysis methods, and reporting standards
